description: Door-to-door travel MCP + CLI: flights, hotels, trains, cars, ferries. No API keys, Go binary.
name: io.github.MikkoParkkola/trvl

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for HTTP-mode auth (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Read-scoped bearer token for HTTP-mode auth (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_READ_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Write-scoped bearer token for HTTP-mode auth (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth token introspection endpoint for HTTP-mode auth (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_OAUTH_INTROSPECTION_URL

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID for HTTP-mode token introspection (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret for HTTP-mode token introspection (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Expected OAuth audience for HTTP-mode token introspection (unused in stdio). Optional.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Selects which MCP tool set is registered (e.g. smart/full). Optional, defaults to full set.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_TOOL_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout override. Optional, defaults to the built-in timeout.
environmentVariables.name: TRVL_MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Air France-KLM API key; unlocks that airline's live fares/award search. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: AFKLM_KEY

environmentVariables.description: 1Password reference for the Air France-KLM API key. Optional, alternative to AFKLM_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: AFKLM_OP_REF

environmentVariables.description: macOS Keychain service name to read the Air France-KLM API key from. Optional, alternative to AFKLM_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: AFKLM_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE

environmentVariables.description: Session cookies for Air France-KLM award search. Optional, unlocks award-fare lookups only.
environmentVariables.name: AFKL_KLM_COOKIES

environmentVariables.description: SerpApi API key; unlocks search-engine-backed lookups used by some providers. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: SERPAPI_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Travelpayouts API token; unlocks that flight-price data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: TRAVELPAYOUTS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Transavia API key; unlocks that airline's live fares. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: TRANSAVIA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Ticketmaster API key; unlocks event listings for destinations. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: TICKETMASTER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Foursquare API key; unlocks that place-search data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: FOURSQUARE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenTripMap API key; unlocks that attractions data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: OPENTRIPMAP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Geoapify API key; unlocks that places/geocoding data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: GEOAPIFY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Distribusion API key; unlocks that ground-transport data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: DISTRIBUSION_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Skyscanner API key; unlocks that car-hire data source. Optional, trvl works without it.
environmentVariables.name: SKYSCANNER_API_KEY

title: trvl
